title: AME-End of Line Test Engineer leader
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Vertiv is recruiting a Lead EOL Test Engineer to design, develop and deploy automated end-of-line test systems covering Hi-Pot test, pre-Run-in functional test, Run-in test and post-Run-in functional test for UPS, DC power etc. power products across global manufacturing sites. This role owns the full lifecycle development of standardized automated test platforms based on LabVIEW and TestStand, undertakes continuous test script optimization, code refactoring and efficiency iteration, reads and analyzes circuit schematic diagrams to precisely classify failure root causes, drives R&D teams and external suppliers to fulfill 100% full test coverage targets for all product functional and electrical parameters, and supports customer and third-party witness test validation. The incumbent will drive test standardization, platform unification, test script performance improvement, yield improvement and test cost optimization to support high-volume, high-quality mass production. Ideal candidates shall have solid experience in automated test platform architecture design, reusable test module development, test script tuning, failure discrimination diagnosis and stable EOL test system deployment for power electronics products.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead full lifecycle EOL test solution development covering four core test stages: Hi-Pot insulation test, pre-Run-in functional test, Run-in test and post-Run-in final functional test for UPS, DC power (Future include also Thermal product) and related components NPDI projects from prototype validation to mass production release; independently design and build unified automated test platforms based on LabVIEW and TestStand, develop reusable test architecture, modular test sequences and standardized API interfaces to support fast iteration and cross-product migration.
  • Conduct continuous test script optimization, code refactoring, logic simplification and runtime efficiency tuning for existing test programs of Hi-Pot, pre-Run-in, Run-in and post-Run-in test stations etc., eliminate redundant code and invalid test steps, shorten overall test cycle time, improve program stability and reduce program crash rate in mass production.
  • Read and interpret hardware circuit schematic diagrams accurately when test failure occurs across Hi-Pot, Run-in and all functional test links; perform targeted fault diagnosis to clearly distinguish whether the failure originates from defective DUT hardware product itself, abnormal test platform hardware, unreasonable test parameter range or flawed test script logic.
  • Define complete test item libraries covering Hi-Pot safety indicators, pre-Run-in electrical performance, Run-in steady-state operating parameters and post-Run-in recheck specifications; proactively drive internal R&D design teams and external component/solution suppliers to implement and reach 100% full test coverage on all electrical, functional and safety-related parameters; establish test coverage audit mechanism and test matrix to guarantee zero missed test items before product shipment.
  • Standardize and execute customer and third-party witness test procedures covering full EOL test flow verification, organize on-site witness validation, compile official witness test reports, and ensure all test activities comply with customer audit standards and factory outgoing quality specifications.
  • Conduct test process feasibility analysis, cycle time simulation and risk assessment for test cells to optimize test flow, reduce testing duration and improve overall line OEE and production throughput.
  • Apply DFT (Design for Test) principles in early product development phase, review hardware and mechanical design for testability checks, identify test blind spots, push R&D and suppliers to deliver design revisions, and propose design optimization to improve test efficiency and coverage.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Plastiikkakirurgian osasto
description:
Hei Sairaanhoitaja! Kiinnostaisiko sinua plastiikkakirurginen hoitotyö Jorvin sairaalan plastiikkaosastolla? Haemme sairaanhoitajaa vakinaiseen toimeen HUS Tukielin- ja plastiikkakirurgian yksikköön Jorvin sairaalaan. Osastollamme on 15 sairaansijaa. Muutamme syksyllä 2026 uuteen sairaalaan ja uusiin tiloihin.

Plastiikkakirurgiassa yleisimpiä toimenpiteitä ovat mm. rinnankorjausleikkaukset, iho- tai pehmytkudoskasvainten-, painehaavojen-, palovammojen-, synnynnäisten epämuodostumien- ja erilaisten haavojen korjausleikkaukset. Haavahoidon osaaminen korostuu hoitotyössä. Potilaat saapuvat osastollemme usein suoraan päivystyksestä tai suunnitellusti leikkaustoimenpiteeseen mutta myös osastosiirtona tai tehohoidon kautta.

Arvostamme
* innostunutta asennetta uuden oppimiseen
* hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja: hyvä hoito syntyy potilaan ja moniammatillisen yhteistyön tuloksena
* innovatiivista ja kehittävää työotetta
* Kokemus kirurgisen potilaan hoitotyöstä ja haavanhoidosta katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle iloisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet. Yksilöllisen perehdytyksen tukena ovat opetushoitaja, perehdytysvastaava, kollegat, apulaisosastonhoitaja ja osastonhoitaja. Kokemus plastiikkakirurgistenpotilaiden hoidosta katsotaan eduksi mutta ei edellytykseksi. Yksilöllisellä perehdytyksellä työkokemus huomioiden sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittyä kirurgisen hoitotyön huippuosaajaksi! Tuemme työ- ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista yhteisöllisen ja toimintalähtöisen työvuorosuunnittelun avulla. Teemme työtä moniammatillisesti.

Sairaanhoitajan työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja alkaa 5.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

HUSin työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu esim. vuosittain jaettava kulttuuri- ja liikunta- ja työsuhdematkalippuetu ePassi (vuonna 2025–300 €), henkilöstölle vuokrattavat loma-asunnot sekä liikunta- ja hyvinvointiyritysten henkilökunta-alennuksia. Jorvin sairaalassa on edullinen pysäköinti (16€/kk) ja työsuhdeasuntoja sairaalan läheisyydessä.

Sairaanhoitajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3218,18€/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät. Palkka nousee palkkaohjelman mukaisesti siinä vaiheessa, kun työhösi sisältyy erikoissairaanhoidon vaativien perustehtävien lisäksi laaja-alaista ja syvällistä osaamista edellyttäviä erityistehtäviä.

Tulet töihin Operatiiviselle tulosalueelle, jossa hoitajat tekevät yhteistyötä muuttuvissa päivystystilanteissa varmistaen turvallisen potilashoidon. Työskentelet tarvittaessa myös oman osaston ulkopuolella yhdessä suunniteltujen potilaskeskeistentoimintamallien mukaan.

Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta lisää. Vastaisitko hakukirjeessäsi lyhyesti seuraaviin kysymyksiin:
1. Millainen kokemus sinulla on haavanhoidosta ja miten kuvailisit osaamistasi tällä alueella?
2. Miten toimit työyhteisön jäsenenä ja millaista yhteistyötä arvostat työssäsi?

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.

title: OSTR Technician
description:
Pay: 2,500.00 (SGD) - 3,000.00 (SGD) per month

Job description:

About Indicon

Indicon specializes in state-of-the-art Controls Design. Our core capabilities include Conveyor Controls, Tooling Controls, Aarell Process Controls, Vision System Integration, and UL‑Certified Control Systems.

Job Purpose

To carry out troubleshooting of controllers, electrical panels, and assemblies at customer sites. This role involves working at customer sites. Adherence to all requirements and expectations of those sites is mandated (Safety, PPE, etc.).

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform troubleshooting of panels, controls, and electrical assemblies
  • Conduct corrective actions or repairs using approved equipment and methods.
  • Document all findings and corrective actions accurately (computer logs, forms, photographs, video whenever possible).
  • Refer to assembly drawing and schematics.
  • Comply with LOTO (Lock‑Out Tag‑Out) procedures.
  • Complete documentation requirements, both paper and electronic.
  • Provide reports on same day as repairs are conducted.
  • Connect and disconnect a variety of cables, harnesses, and test interfaces.

Required Competencies & Traits

  • Ability to comply with all company safety standards and WSH regulations.
  • Team player with strong independent work habits.
  • Mechanical/electrical sub‑assembly knowledge.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic mechanical layout drawings and schematics.
  • Familiarity with Red Tag / Non‑conformance tagging systems.
  • Ability to understand and apply work instructions.
  • Competence using common hand and power tools (drills, torque tools, etc.).
  • Ability to read and use quality checklists.
  • Ability to work efficiently and self motivated.
  • Ethical, reliable, and conscientious.

Essential Physical Requirements

  • May sit or stand while performing duties.
  • Able to lift up to 12 kg (approx. 25 lbs) occasionally.
  • No conductive jewelry or accessories should be worn while performing OSTR duties.
  • Sitting: 50–55%
  • Standing: 30–35%
  • Walking / reaching / bending: 5–10%

Education & Experience Requirements

Required:

  • Education in electrical principles and technologies, or equivalent work experience.
  • Electrical background or prior manufacturing floor experience (Assembly, Verification, and Inspection).
  • Strong experience in testing department and knowledge of panel assembly operations and functions.
  • Ability to understand engineering diagrams, schematics, and relay technical communication.
  • STRONG troubleshooting abilities.

Things to note:

OSTR role needs to have transportation, along with being able to be on call, not all time need to dispatch but at least to be able to respond to AMAT regarding potential OSTR calls. We will be providing allownace for that. the OSTR should also have electrical background, along with being able to test fully functional panels.

When OSTR is not on call, require to work in production or test to support production.

Computer Skills:

  • Windows OS

· Microsoft office

· Itools Software

· CCI Software

· Pheonix Contact Software

· Flir Software

  • Syteline ERP system

Working Environment

  • Work conducted at customer sites may require using ladders, harnesses, full body PPE, hand tools, and digital multimeters. Work should be conduct on de-energized equipment only.
  • Work conducted in an electrical test cell, while at Indicon facility, requires working with energized equipment from 208 VAC to 480 VAC.
  • Must adhere to required testing PPE: long-sleeved FR clothing, long pants, safety EH rated shoes, arc‑flash helmet/shield, and Electrical rated gloves with leather protectors when testing.
  • Must adhere to standard testing practices while working with energized equipment (19-steps ESWP).

Employment Requirements (Singapore)

  • Must be legally authorized to work in Singapore in compliance with MOM regulations.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Indicon is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, religion, gender, marital status, family responsibilities, disability, or any other characteristic protected under Singapore law.

Additional Notes

The above statements describe the general nature and scope of work. They do not represent an exhaustive list of duties or competencies required. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with Singapore’s Enabling Masterplan guidelines.

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Free parking
  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Dcode is seeking a high-performing Program Manager to support a dynamic, fast-paced innovation environment embedded within the U.S. Army.

This role supports rapid capability development efforts in close collaboration with industry, academia, active-duty personnel, and senior Army acquisition stakeholders. You will help operational commands identify needs, rapidly prototype solutions, and transition capabilities efficiently, working alongside the client.

You’ll manage projects from kickoff to delivery, coordinate multidisciplinary teams (including Dcode Field Experts), and work directly with senior military and government leaders. The work blends program management, agile delivery, stakeholder facilitation, and technical fluency, with exposure to software-enabled capabilities, automation, and AI/ML-adjacent efforts.

One day you might be planning an agile sprint for a rapid prototype, the next, facilitating a workshop with operators, developers, and acquisition professionals. This is meaningful, mission-driven work for someone who thrives in ambiguity and execution.

Duty Station: Fort Bragg, NC

Salary range: $98,000-$130,000 plus bi-annual bonuses.

Top Secret clearance or higher is strongly preferred. Eligibility for clearance is required.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to Army and DoW stakeholders operating within the corps and acquisition ecosystems.

  • Facilitate collaboration across multiple organizations.
  • Lead workshops, write assessments, and convert complex operational and technical challenges into clear recommendations.
  • Continuously collect feedback and refine delivery approaches to improve outcomes and user experience.

Program and Project Delivery

  • Manage day-to-day delivery for assigned workstream(s), producing high quality deliverables and measurable outcomes for your clients.
  • Define and track performance metrics to evaluate progress towards objectives, ensuring Dcode’s support drives outsized mission and organizational value.
  • Apply agile and Scrum methodologies to plan, execute, and adapt projects based on real-time feedback.
  • Identify and help implement automation opportunities to make processes faster and more efficient.
  • Work closely with technical contributors and Systems Developers to ensure requirements, timelines, and dependencies are aligned.
  • Coordinate closely with Dcode leadership and Field Experts to bring the right expertise into projects at the right time.
  • Track progress against milestones and communicate updates clearly and frequently to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support rapid prototyping and experimentation efforts tied to software-enabled capabilities.

Technical & Systems Support (Program-Level)

  • Partner with Systems Developers and technical teams supporting technical capability efforts.
  • Contribute to planning and oversight of technical development and integration activities, including testing, deployment, and sustainment considerations.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging cUAS technologies and software development best practices to inform planning and decision-making.
  • Help ensure interoperability, security, and compliance with DoD/DoW regulations throughout delivery efforts.
  • Support documentation efforts, including requirements, design artifacts, user guidance, and lessons learned.

Operational & Contract Management

  • Understand and manage contract requirements to ensure compliance and effective delivery.
  • Identify risks early and work with leadership to mitigate issues quickly.
  • Capture lessons learned and recommended improvements to processes, tools, and workflows.
  • Support efforts to remove policy, acquisition, and operational barriers to innovation.
  • Implement solutions that make delivery more efficient and scalable.

Qualifications

KEY SKILLS

  • 5+ years of acquisition and project/program management experience in a federal, DoW, or defense-adjacent environment.
  • Experience working in innovation-focused organizations, rapid capability offices, labs, or operational experimentation environments.
  • Strong understanding of agile project management principles; hands-on Scrum experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with material acquisition, systems engineering, or rapid prototyping efforts.
  • 1+ years of cUAS experience, preferably in a federal or DoW environment.
  • Experience managing client-facing initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Comfort operating in collaborative environments with military personnel, government civilians, technical experts, and senior leaders with the professionalism, discretion, and situational awareness required to navigate high-stakes discussions and drive alignment across diverse priorities.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently, solve problems, and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • A track record of problem-solving, working independently, and delivering results.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or ability to lead a Scrum.

Additional Information

You’ll love it here if:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, mission-driven environments.
  • Love figuring out how to make big, complex things run smoothly.
  • Are energized by working with smart, passionate teammates.
  • Don’t wait for permission to fix problems or seize opportunities.
  • Can give and take feedback without ego.
  • Bring energy, creativity, and persistence to everything you do.

Our CEO busted her face on the balance beam in college and got back up… our CRO knocked on a thousand doors, was rejected 999 times, and kept on knocking... What is your story?

title: Payment Graduates
description:
What can I expect from the programme?

Our Graduate Programme will give you an experience like no other, working within our Payments team. Payments sits at the heart of how customers, businesses and communities move money every day. You will help support reliable, safe and efficient payment services while learning how banking, operations, technology, risk and customer experience come together.

Our current programme is based in Auckland and will run for approximately 10-12 months. You’ll start with us as a permanent employee in February 2027 on an immersive orientation which will help grow your understanding of Westpac NZ along with the wider grad cohort. At the end of your programme, you’ll be supported to find a suitable role that matches your capabilities and interests within your business area.

Throughout the programme:

Payments champions, leaders and mentors will support you during the programme experience. The programme is structured to help you identify your focus areas, while tailored training sessions build and strengthen your technical and soft skills, accelerating your personal and professional career development. Expect to give back by joining communities, volunteering and sustainability initiatives, rounding out your whole work life experience.

The day to day:

As a Payments Graduate, you’ll gain exposure to the systems, processes and people that help customers send and receive money accurately, securely and on time. Depending on business needs and your interests, your pathway may include:

Payments Analyst - support the day-to-day performance of payment systems, help monitor transactions, identify issues, and improve how customers send and receive money.

Payments Operations Analyst - work with internal teams to manage payment processing, resolve queries, and ensure payments are completed accurately, on time, and in line with regulatory requirements.

Payments Change & Delivery Analyst - assist in delivering new payment features and improvements by working with technology and business teams to test, implement, and embed changes into customer and internal processes.

You may also:

  • Learn how payments flow across digital, operational and banking channels

  • Support simple analysis, reporting and problem solving across payment processes

  • Work with teams across technology, operations, risk, compliance and product

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that make payments easier and more reliable for customers

  • Build confidence working in a regulated banking environment where accuracy, customer outcomes and trust matter

Ōu Pūkenga | About You

To be eligible, you must be in your final year of study or have completed an undergraduate or postgraduate degree within the past 12 months. Our Graduate opportunities are entry level roles giving those on the programme broad exposure across the relevant business unit. Additionally, applicants must be New Zealand or Australian citizens or permanent residents.

We’re looking for graduates who are curious, practical and motivated to learn. You do not need to be a payments expert already. What matters is that you bring a customer mindset, strong attention to detail, a willingness to work with others to solve problems and have:

  • Interest in banking, payments, operations, technology, customer experience or business improvement

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to ask questions

  • Good attention to detail and an organised approach to work

  • Comfort working with information, processes and systems

  • A collaborative style and willingness to learn from different teams

  • A growth mindset and enthusiasm for building your career at Westpac NZ

Ko mātou tēnei | Our Organisation
At Westpac, we’re working together to build a fairer and stronger New Zealand for our people, customers, and communities. For over 160 years we’ve been driven by our purpose to Create Better Futures Together.

What makes us unique are the incredible people we’re lucky enough to have walk through our doors every day. The giant ‘W’ on our building doesn’t just stand for Westpac – it says, double you. We’re a place that values, rewards and recognises individuality. Where you can be your whole self, your true self, and your best self. We’re recognised as a place where talent is developed, where passions are fuelled and where ambitions of all shapes and sizes thrive. And it all starts with you!

Tono mai ināianei! | Apply Now!

Apply today with your CV and Cover Letter.

The people of Aotearoa, New Zealand hail from many cultures and backgrounds. At Westpac New Zealand, we draw on this enormous talent pool to cultivate a team rich in ability and empowered to reach its full potential. Our aim is to be brave challengers, celebrating our differences and relentlessly advocating for our customers. It starts with us – we believe that when we care deeply and do our best for our people, they’ll do their best for our customers. We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, including those who are neurodiverse, have chronic health conditions or disabilities – your attitude and passion are as important to us as your experience, qualifications and capabilities.

Mahi tahi tātou, kaha ake tātou | Together Greater

description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

Responsible for the day-to-day program operations and supporting the growth of the assigned single site Home Therapies program in coordination with the Business Unit management, in-center staff and other support functions. Ensures provision of quality patient care in accordance with policies, procedures, and training.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides safe and effective oversight, support, training and scheduling of the delivery of home dialysis therapies to patients in compliance with standards outlined in the facility policy procedure manuals, as well as regulations set forth by the corporation, state, and federal agencies.
  • Responsible for profit and loss management of the assigned program including optimal performance of program operations to achieve or exceed budgets and key performance indicators.
  • Directs and manages all aspects of patient care for Home Therapies patients in assigned programs from admission through discharge of the patient. Provides direction, guidance, and support to staff members to ensure the safe and effective delivery of home therapy support care to patients with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD).
  • Oversees patient and caregiver readiness and ability to perform dialysis treatments at home and assesses environment for suitability in the ongoing delivery of home dialysis therapy, including training patients and caregivers on the safe and effective operation and preventative maintenance of equipment.
  • Manages patient experience efforts by supporting company patient satisfaction initiatives, embodying the company values and patient experience drivers while encouraging others to do the same.
  • Ensures competency of staff in the operation of all home dialysis therapy-related equipment, including the ability to troubleshoot equipment problems with the patient via telephone, maintaining appropriate staff licensures and CPR certifications.
  • Responsible for management of program supplies, equipment tracking, ensures that orders are replenished in a consistent and timely manner.
  • Directs activities related to the Continuous Quality Assurance Improvement, patient retention and Clinical Algorithm Adoption, patient access management and patient training success.
  • Directs data entry related activities such as patient admission, regulatory reporting, billing, physician orders, lab results, vital signs, patient status and any other treatment related data into systems.
  • Ensures regulatory, compliance, and audit activities are accomplished on time.
  • Orients and supports new staff and provides ongoing education, ensuring compliance with all risk management initiatives, including in-center staff.
  • Participates in Business Unit initiatives, projects, and audits as directed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials.
  • The position provides direct patient care that regularly involves heavy lifting and moving of patients and assisting with ambulation. Equipment used can vary in complexity. Equipment aids and/or coworkers may provide assistance.
  • The employee may occasionally be required to move, with assistance, machines and equipment of up to 200 lbs., and may lift chemical and water solutions of up to 30 lbs. up as high as 5 feet. There is a two-person assist program and "material assist" devices for the heavier items.
  • This position requires frequent, prolonged periods of standing and/or walking and the employee must be able to bend over.
  • Employees are required to take the Ishihara's Color Blindness test as a condition of employment. Note that: Failing the Ishihara Test for Color Blindness does not preclude employment. The Company will consider whether reasonable accommodations can be made.

SUPERVISION:

  • Typically supervises non-exempt staff

EDUCATION AND REQUIRED CREDENTIALS:

  • Graduate of an accredited School of Nursing (R.N.). Current appropriate state licensure.
  • Successfully complete CPR Certification

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:

  • Minimum of one year dialysis experience with three months peritoneal experience required, one year medical-surgical nursing or ICU experience preferred
  • Supervisory experience preferred
  • Successfully complete a training course in the theory and practice of dialysis therapies
  • Demonstrated leadership skills including, but not limited to communication, customer service, performance management and continuous quality improvement.

title: Digital Graduate
description:
What can I expect from the programme?

Our Graduate programme will give you an experience like no other working within our dynamic Digital team. You'll join Westpac at an exciting time as we reimagine banking through digital innovation, data, emerging technologies and customer-centred design. We are offering a permanent graduate position on a tailored programme which has been designed accelerate your growth, broaden your experience with future leaders in mind.

Our current programme is based in Auckland and will run for approximately 10-12 months. You’ll start with us as a permanent employee in February 2027 on an immersive orientation which will help grow your understanding of Westpac NZ along with the wider grad cohort. Throughout the programme, you'll develop a broad understanding of how Digital works across product, customer experience, data, technology and delivery. You'll build valuable relationships across the organisation while gaining exposure to leaders, teams and initiatives shaping the future of Westpac. At the end of your programme, you’ll be supported to find a suitable role that matches your capabilities and interests within your business area.

Throughout the programme:

Digital Champions, leaders and mentors will support you during the programme experience. The programme is structured to help you identify your focus areas whilst tailored training sessions build and strengthen your technical and soft skills - accelerating your personal and professional career development. Expect to be able to give back by joining numerous communities, volunteering and sustainability initiatives rounding out your whole work life experience.

You can expect:

  • Structured learning and development experiences
  • Dedicated mentoring and coaching from Digital leaders
  • Exposure to Product Management, Customer Experience, Digital Channels, Data & Analytics, Technology and Transformation
  • Opportunities to collaborate with teams across Westpac
  • Access to networking, leadership and graduate events
  • Involvement in community, sustainability and volunteering initiatives
  • A clear pathway into your next role after the programme

The day to day:

  • Our Digital team is helping shape the future of banking in New Zealand by delivering intelligent, personalised and customer-focused digital experiences
  • Every day, hundreds of thousands of New Zealanders use Westpac's digital channels to manage their financial lives. You'll contribute to meaningful work that helps improve those experiences
  • You will work alongside Product Managers, Digital Channel Specialists, Customer Experience professionals, Analysts, Designers and Technology teams responsible for building and delivering digital solutions
  • Depending on where your strengths and interests lie, you may support the design, testing and delivery of new products, features and customer experiences across mobile and online banking channels
  • You will have opportunities to use customer insights and data to identify opportunities, solve problems and improve outcomes for customers
  • As Digital, Technology and Transformation work closely together, you'll gain exposure to a range of functions and learn how large-scale digital initiatives are delivered
  • You'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies including AI, automation and open banking, and understand how they can create better banking experiences
  • Westpac NZ continues to invest significantly in Digital and Technology, making it an exciting time to learn, grow and help build the future of banking
  • Support and coaching with a buddy and mentor: You will receive a mentor who will provide coaching and help you take charge of your development and career planning while navigating life at Westpac
  • Expect plenty of opportunities to get involved in grad life where you can build your networks and friendships with those you work with, including business leaders
  • Expect to be able to give back. Join numerous communities, volunteering and sustainability initiatives rounding out your whole work life experience

Ōu Pūkenga | About You

To be eligible, you must be in your final year of study or have completed an undergraduate or postgraduate degree within the past 12 months. Our Graduate opportunities are entry level roles giving those on the programme broad exposure across the relevant business unit. Additionally, applicants must be New Zealand or Australian citizens or permanent residents.

You might come from a background in:

• Business or Commerce
• Information Systems
• Computer Science or Technology
• Data & Analytics
• Engineering
• Design or Customer Experience
• Or another discipline where you've demonstrated problem-solving, innovation and curiosity

We are looking to fill our program with original thinkers, innovators, and team players who are highly collaborative. You will have a Computer Science degree or equivalent, examples of relevant technology experience during your study and the ability to recognise areas of opportunity, to adapt, innovate and to drive productivity.

• Curious about how technology can improve people's lives
• Passionate about digital experiences, products and innovation
• Customer-focused and motivated by solving real problems
• Collaborative and comfortable working with different perspectives
• Adaptable, resilient and eager to learn
• Analytical thinkers who enjoy turning ideas into action
• Strong communicators who can build relationships and influence others

• You will have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal), be super curious, be customer-centric and be resilient, with high levels of personal integrity, professionalism, and drive.

Ko mātou tēnei | Our Organisation
At Westpac, we’re working together to build a fairer and stronger New Zealand for our people, customers, and communities. For over 160 years we’ve been driven by our purpose to Create Better Futures Together.

What makes us unique are the incredible people we’re lucky enough to have walk through our doors every day. The giant ‘W’ on our building doesn’t just stand for Westpac – it says, double you. We’re a place that values, rewards and recognises individuality. Where you can be your whole self, your true self, and your best self. We’re recognised as a place where talent is developed, where passions are fuelled and where ambitions of all shapes and sizes thrive. And it all starts with you!

Tono mai ināianei! | Apply Now!

Apply today with your CV and Cover Letter.

The people of Aotearoa, New Zealand hail from many cultures and backgrounds. At Westpac New Zealand, we draw on this enormous talent pool to cultivate a team rich in ability and empowered to reach its full potential. Our aim is to be brave challengers, celebrating our differences and relentlessly advocating for our customers. It starts with us – we believe that when we care deeply and do our best for our people, they’ll do their best for our customers. We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, including those who are neurodiverse, have chronic health conditions or disabilities – your attitude and passion are as important to us as your experience, qualifications and capabilities.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Allergiasairauksien Lastenyksikkö
description:
Oletko kiinnostunut päivätyöstä lasten ja nuorten allergiasairauksien parissa?

Haemme Tulehduskeskuksen allergialinjan lastenyksikköön sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen toimeen 17.8.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tule rakentamaan vahvaa allergiaosaamista lastenyksikköön!

Yksiköstämme

Lastenyksikössämme pääset työskentelemään monipuolisessa ja asiantuntevassa ympäristössä lasten ja nuorten allergiasairauksien parissa. Tutkimme ja hoidamme 0–16-vuotiaiden potilaiden atooppista ihottumaa, ruoka-allergioita, astmaa sekä muita allergisia sairauksia.

Meillä potilaan ja perheen kohtaaminen sekä laadukas ohjaus ovat keskeinen osa jokapäiväistä työtä. Työ on vaihtelevaa päivätyötä ja allergialinjassa tarjoamme monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia työssä oppimiseen. Meillä pääset osaksi asiantuntevaa työyhteisöä ja saat hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme merkityksellisen työn lasten ja nuorten terveyden edistämisen parissa, mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun sekä lämpimän ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen. Pääset kehittämään osaamistasi allergiasairauksien asiantuntijana osana moniammatillista tiimiä. Osallistumme aktiivisesti allergialinjan tutkimusprojekteihin, ohjaamme opiskelijoita sekä koulutamme terveydenhuollon ammattilaisia niin organisaation sisällä kuin sen ulkopuolellakin.

Toivomme sinulta

Etsimme joukkoomme yhteistyökykyistä ja oma-aloitteista ammattilaista, jolla on hyvät tiimityö- ja asiakaspalvelutaidot sekä kyky organisoida omaa työtään. title: Senior Instrument & Control Engineer
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for leading the design, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning of Instrumentation & Control (I&C) and Extra-Low Voltage (ELV) systems across large-scale projects from tender stage through final client acceptance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of ELV systems throughout the project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

  • Coordinate ELV supervisors and multi disciplinary project stakeholders.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of vendor submissions and approve shop drawings.
  • Develop testing and commissioning procedures and manage subcontractors during commissioning activities.
  • Guide engineers and designer sin preparing cable routing plans, wiring diagrams, schedules, and control system schematics.

Qualifications& Experience

  • Degree in Instrumentation &Controls Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in engineering design and construction.
  • Experience in design, installation, programming, and commissioning process and building control systems.
  • Hands-on experience with ELV systems, including Fire Alarm, Security Systems, and IT/Data Networks.
  • Experience in advanced technology facilities, life sciences, chemical, energy, and high-tech infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of construction management and project execution.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Instrumentation & Control engineering principles.
  • Experience with process automation and industrial control systems.
  • Proficiency in engineering documentation, schematics, and technical drawings.
  • Knowledge of testing, commissioning, and system integration practices.
  • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and manage vendor interfaces.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and results-driven.

title: Commissioning Supervisor - Process

Designing the future. Transforming the World.

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges

title: Resilience Specialist (Business Continuity)
description:
Kia ora!

Help strengthen the resilience of one of New Zealand's most iconic organisations. As our Resilience Specialist (Business Continuity), you'll play a critical role in ensuring Air New Zealand can continue delivering for our customers, people and communities when it matters most. Your work will help protect essential operations, minimise disruption and build confidence across the business. We welcome candidates who bring strong experience, fresh thinking and transferable skills to help us continue evolving our resilience capability.

  • Strong analytical capability, with experience conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, business impact assessments and risk evaluation
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence and ability to influence leaders, presenting complex information clearly and ensuring business continuity is prioritised accordingly
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into practical, business-focused solutions
  • Comfortable working in dynamic environments, managing ambiguity and balancing priorities independently and collaboratively
  • Advanced tertiary qualifications are preferred in Business, Engineering, Science, Aviation, Computing, Risk Management, or a related discipline. Qualifications in business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency management, or crisis management will be highly regarded.

Ready for take-off?

If you're passionate about strengthening organisational resilience, influencing meaningful change, and helping Air New Zealand prepare for tomorrow's challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Join a team where your expertise will make a lasting impact across one of New Zealand's most trusted and innovative organisations.

title: Component Engineer, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Component Engineer at Amazon Leo, you will be responsible for supporting the Component Engineering team by supporting the management of Leo’s approved component library and developing component engineering processes and mechanisms. You will work with Senior Component Engineers to solve technical problems involving electrical component research, qualification, and obsolescence. Your role will play a critical part in the success of current and next generation Leo satellites.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Expertise
-Serve as Subject Matter Expert providing technical guidance to Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing teams
-Manage Component Failure Analysis and drive Corrective Actions with suppliers

Process & Library Management
-Create, review, improve, and maintain Component Engineering methods, processes, and procedures
-Contribute to Electrical Component Lifecycle Management across all satellite programs
-Maintain and expand the approved component library through rigorous research

Component Evaluation & Selection
-Review Electrical Component Requests for requirements compliance
-Research alternative components to optimize satellite designs
-Conduct equivalency research to expand component options
-Perform BOM scrubs and review electrical schematics and layouts

Cross-Functional Collaboration
-Partner with design, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams
-Support current production and next-generation satellite development

A day in the life
You'll protect mission integrity daily. You'll review Product Change Notifications, making critical decisions impacting satellite reliability. You'll conduct rigorous BOM scrubs, enabling zero failure on orbit.
You'll collaborate with brilliant engineers solving complex obsolescence challenges. You'll evaluate components for space environments. You'll maintain our approved parts library and serve as technical authority. Your work directly enables Amazon's vision of global connectivity from space.


About the team
The Component Engineering team ensures mission success for Amazon's LEO satellite constellation. We manage every electrical component from selection through end-of-life, ensuring parts withstand space conditions—radiation, thermal cycling, and vacuum.
We maintain Leo's approved component library. We drive qualification processes. We solve complex obsolescence challenges. We bridge design ambition and manufacturing reality, partnering across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing.

Our rigorous evaluation, testing, and lifecycle management enable innovation while protecting mission integrity. We ensure Amazon's global connectivity vision is built on proven, reliable components that perform flawlessly in space's harshest environment. Building the future of space infrastructure, one component at a time.

title: Animal Welfare Officer (Rescue)
company: Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, Singapore
description:
Roles & Responsibilities :

The Animal Welfare Officer is responsible for attending to animal rescue cases. This includes retrieving animals, assessing rescued animals, and transportation of them back to the shelter or veterinary clinics for housing and medical attention.

The incumbent is expected to work in a shift system that encompasses public holidays and weekends. He/she needs to be physically fit in order to attend to animal rescue cases. He/she works largely in outdoor environments and through various weather conditions. The Animal Welfare Officer is expected to spend long hours driving to attend to rescue calls. When he/she is not attending to rescue calls, he/she is expected to assist in the care of animals within the shelter.

  • Respond to animal rescue calls within a stipulated time frame
  • Prioritise animal rescues according to level of risk and urgency
  • Attend to animal rescue cases according to the organisation’s safety protocols
  • Transport animals to the shelter or nearest veterinary clinic for housing and medical attention
  • Ensure that rescue vehicles, carriers, and all equipment are well-maintained and clean

Value Add of Position

  • Able to attend to rescue calls effectively and seek relevant medical needs

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education: Minimum GCE “N” or “O” level
  • Experience: At least 1 – 2 years of animal handling experience
  • Valid Class 3/3A driving license, at least 2 years driving experience
  • Good road sense
  • Patient and diplomatic
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills

Technical Competencies:

Animal Handling and Restraint

  • Safe and humane capture of frightened, injured, or aggressive animals
  • Use of appropriate equipment (e.g. catch poles, muzzles, nets, cages)
  • Understanding species-specific behaviours to minimise stress/injury

Operation of Rescue Equipment

  • Operating rescue vehicles and loading/unloading animals safely
  • Use of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in field operations and ensure personal and public safety

Knowledge of Animal Welfare Laws and SOPs

  • Familiarity with animal welfare legislation (e.g. Animals and Birds Act)
  • Adhering to Standard Operating Procedures and legal protocols

Incident Reporting and Documentation

  • Accurate completion of case reports, incident logs, and follow-ups
  • Use of digital tools or field apps to input rescue data
  • Photographing and documenting conditions for evidence when needed

Behavioural competencies:

  • Situational adaptability
  • Customer Focus
  • Drives vision and purpose
  • Optimizes work processes
  • Resourcefulness

title: Senior Staff Engineer - SAS Programmer
description:
Job Description : SAS Programmer/Analyst (Marketing Research) we need a skilled SAS programmer to own and enhance data pipelines and deliverables for a large, ongoing, table-driven marketing research study. The person will be the primary point of contact for extracting data from SQL databases, transforming and validating it in SAS, and producing standardized SAS/SPSS/CSV datasets and documentation for internal stakeholders and clients.

Key responsibilities

  • Data engineering and pipelines
  • Extract, transform, and load (ETL) study data from SQL databases into SAS using DATA step, PROC SQL, and parameterized, table-driven control logic.
  • Maintain and optimize reusable SAS macros/code libraries; ensure jobs are modular, performant, and well documented.
  • Build and maintain SPSS and CSV flat-file exports from SAS with consistent schemas, encodings, and delivery packaging.
  • Manage SAS ATTRIBs, informats, labels, and user-defined formats via controlled format catalogs to preserve metadata consistency across waves and clients.
  • Standardized datasets and deliverables
    • Maintain a portfolio of standardized datasets (SAS, SPSS, CSV) for internal analysis and external client distribution.
    • Produce proprietary client-specific SAS datasets per specification, including variable derivations, naming conventions, labels, formats, and delivery schedules.
    • Generate data dictionaries, layout specs, and change logs for every release; ensure version control and reproducibility. Variable creation and logic implementation
    • Develop, maintain, and run SAS programs to construct complex proprietary variables based on written specifications and table-driven rules.
    • Implement table-driven business logic and parameter files to support multi-client, multi-wave production at scale.
  • Quality assurance and validation
    • Design and maintain SAS-based validation checks (unit tests, reconciliations, row/column balances, referential integrity) with automated exception logs.
    • Verify calculations and transformations against specifications, prior waves, and independent SPSS outputs.
  • Collaboration and support
    • Support ad hoc data pulls and one-off deliverables with clear scoping and reproducibility.
    • Contribute to standards, SOPs, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the data production process.

Minimum qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on SAS programming in a production environment (Base SAS, PROC SQL, Macro facility, DATA step).
  • Proven experience extracting from SQL databases and transforming data into SAS and SPSS deliverables.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort documenting processes and data dictionaries.
  • Demonstrated experience building automated QC/validation checks and reconciling results across sources/tools.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and convert them into robust, reusable SAS code.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfort working with cross-functional stakeholders in a deadline-driven setting.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, versioning discipline, and a strong sense of data stewardship.

Must have Skills: SAS, SQL (Strong)

Good To Have Skills: Microsoft Excel

title: AVP, Financial Lines Claims
description:
The Large Commercial Directors & Officers, Financial Lines Assistant Vice President is responsible for investigating and settling high exposure, high risk claims. Ensures high level of customer service and claim file quality. This is a role focused on technical claim handling for Chubb insureds nationwide. In this role you will manage complex directors and officers, transactional risk and financial institutions’ liability claims. This role requires an individual to be accountable for the handling and disposition of claims including investigation, coverage determination, reserving, negotiation and settlement or trial strategies. This position will require some travel, as well as coordinating with and servicing both internal and external business partners. You will represent the company at meetings with management and business partners, as well as at mediations, arbitrations, settlement conferences and trials.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides outstanding customer service and works well with the insured and broker in the adjustment of complex directors and officers, transactional risk and financial institutions liability claims.

  • Analyzes coverage and communicates coverage positions, as warranted, under direction of supervisor and coverage unit.

  • Conducts, coordinates, and directs investigation into loss facts and extent of third-party damages.

  • Direct and closely monitor assignments to experts and defense counsel.

  • Evaluates information on coverage, liability, and damages to determine the extent of exposure to the insured and the company.

  • Sets reserves within authority or makes claim recommendations concerning reserve changes to supervisor.

  • Travels to conferences, mediations, and trials as necessary. Travel ranges from approximately 0% to 25%, but it could be more as dictated by business needs.

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree or JD preferred.

  • Ten or more years’ experience as a claim professional or attorney with a high degree of specialization and technical competence in the handling of high exposure claims with emphasis on hands-on file and litigation management.

  • Financial Lines Liability (FL) experience in Directors & Officers, Financial Institutions and Fiduciary liability claims.

  • Strong background and demonstrated ability in dealing with significant coverage matters, including Additional Insured analyses.

  • An understanding of the tenants of insurance and legal principles.

  • Knowledge of Commercial Insurance Financial Lines coverage and services.

  • Working knowledge of industry best practices and procedures.

  • An ability to work independently and assimilate learning materials on many different subjects from various sources.

  • Excellent interpersonal communications and negotiation skills; and an ability to deal with customers and business partners in a professional manner.

  • Ability to make prompt, intelligent decisions based upon detailed analysis of complex issues.

  • Demonstrated strong relational skills particularly in adverse or high-pressure situations.

  • A law degree is not necessary but recommended.

  • If you do not already have one, you will be required to obtain an applicable resident or designated home state adjusters license and possibly additional state licensure

The pay range for the role is $134,200 to $195,800. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled.

title: 뷰티 커머스 신사업 Business Head
description:
About

[오렌지스퀘어를 소개합니다]
2천만 외국인 관광객이 한국에서 쓰는 돈, 그 전부가 하나의 플랫폼 위에서 움직입니다.

오렌지스퀘어는 그동안 제각각 흩어져 있던 한국 여행의 모든 순간을 처음으로 한자리에 모았습니다. 결제는 물론 교통과 통신, K-뷰티 쇼핑과 K-POP 덕질, K-브랜드·맛집·핫플레이스 추천, 그리고 여행자들이 후기와 정보를 나누는 커뮤니티까지.

이 모든 걸 한 손에 쥐게 하는 서비스가 '와우패스(WOWPASS)'입니다.

와우패스는 일본인 관광객 3명 중 1명, 중화권 관광객 4명 중 1명, 전체 방한객 9명 중 1명이 사용하는 국내 최초 결제·교통·환전을 통합한 올인원 선불카드로 출발하였고, 이제 그 무게 중심은 커머스 플랫폼으로 옮겨가고 있습니다.

외국인이 한국에서 무엇을 사고, 무엇을 먹고, 어디에서 머무는지. 국내 외국인 소비 데이터를 선점하며 새로운 시장을 만들어 갑니다.

△누적 앱 가입자 330만 명 △카드 발급 280만 장 △무인 키오스크 430여 대 △누적 거래액 1조7,000억 원 △20222025 매출 약 30배 성장(253억 원) △3년 연속 영업흑자 유지

정부가 '방한 외국인 3,000만 시대'를 향해 달려가는 지금, 이 시장은 이제 막 문을 열었습니다. 그리고 그 출발선 맨 앞에 우리가 서 있습니다.

이 시장엔 아직 정답이 없습니다. 그 답을 함께 만들어갈 뷰티 커머스 신사업 Business Head를 찾습니다.

Responsibilities

[우리는 이런 일을 해요]
• 와우패스를 활용한 방한 외국인 관광객 대상 K-뷰티 마케팅 및 이커머스 서비스를 기획합니다
• “와우패스 뷰티 세트” 프로그램을 기획·확장하고, 신청부터 배송, 구매 전환까지의 고객 경험을 고도화 합니다
• 뷰티 브랜드사와 협업해, 와우패스를 활용한 단독 구성, 입점, 모바일앱/키오스크 광고 등 온·오프라인 협업 프로그램을 기획하고 추진합니다.
• 초기 뷰티 커머스 사업의 운영 기준, 상품 등록 정책, 사업관리 프로세스를 함께 설계합니다.

Requirements

[우리는 이런 분과 같이 일하고 싶어요]
• 뷰티 카테고리 MD, 이커머스 MD, 브랜드 상품기획, 브랜드 마케팅 중 하나 이상의 경험이 7~12년 이상인 분
• 상품 소싱, 가격/마진 관리, 프로모션 기획, 매출 분석 중 2개 이상을 직접 수행해본 분
• 뷰티 브랜드사 또는 벤더사와의 협업·계약·프로모션 진행 경험이 있는 분
• 해외 고객 대상 뷰티 상품 판매 또는 마케팅 운영 경험이 있는 분

Preferred

• 데이터 기반으로 상품별 매출, 마진, 전환율을 개선해본 경험

Benefits

THE OPPORTUNITY

Are you an experienced shepherd or someone who works outdoors and is looking to start your career in farming? Either way, we have some scope, so this is an opportunity to join our team at Pastoral Organic Dairy.

As a shepherd general, you’ll be part of a team, working closely with the farm manager, who will support your growth and development.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Livestock/pasture management and animal health

  • General farm maintenance and fencing

This is a drive-in/drive-out position.

ABOUT YOU

You’re passionate about farming, love working with livestock, and want to be part of a team that gets results. You’re practical and always looking for ways to do the job better.

You will:

  • Enjoy working with animals and take their welfare seriously

  • Be comfortable keeping accurate records and using farm technology (or keen to learn)

  • Have a valid restricted or full driver licence

We’re proud to have a supportive and inclusive culture at Pāmu. If this role sounds like a good fit for you, but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.


THE PĀMU FARM

Pāmu’s Pastoral Organic Dairy is a 1,032-hectare farming operation spread across four blocks on and around Broadlands Road in Reporoa. The farm supports nearby organic dairy farms by grazing around 1,000 R1s, 1,000 R2s and 1,400 mixed-age cows over winter, as well as producing organic supplement for the wider dairy operation.

You’ll be one of three employees on farm and part of a close-knit wider team that works together across the organic dairy farming system.

BENEFITS

We care about your wellbeing - that’s why we offer health and life insurance, enhanced parental leave benefits, and up to 4% KiwiSaver matching as part of a competitive salary package. You’ll also receive an extra day of leave over Christmas, along with ongoing training and development to help you thrive.

2026 Shepherd General.pdf

title: [쿠팡] 시니어 디자이너 (7년 이상)
description:
About

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀소개

크리에이티브 스튜디오는 영상, 이미지, 텍스트 등 형태를 가리지 않고 고객에게 필요한 정보를 직관적으로 전달하는 컨텐츠를 생산합니다.
광고 영상, 홍보 영상, 상품 사진, 셀링 포인트, 또 다른 효과적인 결과물을 함께 발굴하고 시도하며 창의력과 역량을 발휘합니다.

Responsibilities

1.쿠팡 내 프로모션, 캠페인 페이지 등 주요 디자인 기획/제작
2.로켓프레시 및 로켓배송 상품 상세 페이지 디자인
3.광고 마케팅 배너 에셋 제작
4.고객 안내 컨텐츠 제작
5.디자인 프로젝트의 전체 프로세스를 리드하며, 팀 내 크리에이티브 퀄리티 향상

Requirements

• 7년~10년의 관련 디자인 경력을 보유하신 분
• Adobe Photoshop Expert, Figma 프로그램을 전문적으로 사용할 수 있는 스킬을 가지신 분
• 완성도 높은 그래픽 디자인 스킬과 빠른 시간 내에 창의적인 디자인을 구현할 수 있는 분
• 원활한 커뮤니케이션 스킬과 피드백 수용 능력을 바탕으로 팀워크를 중시하는 분
• 업무에 임하는 진지한 자세와 리더십이 있는 분

Preferred

• 디자인 관련전공이신 분
• 동종업계 경력이 있으신 분

Benefits

흥미롭고 획기적인 업무를 경험하는 것 외에도 쿠팡 직원들에게는 매력적인 복지혜택이 제공됩니다.

title: HIIM Data Integrity Analyst-Validation
description:
Job Summary

The HIIM Data Integrity Analyst-Validation is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of medical records by reviewing, indexing, and validating documentation within the Electronic Health Record (EHR). This role ensures compliance with medical staff bylaws, medical staff rules and regulations, The Joint Commission (TJC) standards, Medicare Conditions of Participation, and other regulatory requirements. The HIIM Data Integrity Analyst assigns deficiencies to providers, verifies document authentication, and ensures that medical records meet compliance standards before being considered complete.

Essential Functions

  • Analyzes and assigns chart deficiencies to providers based on regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and accreditation agency guidelines.
  • Reviews and validates scanned medical records, ensuring proper indexing to the correct facility, patient, and document type.
  • Ensures the integrity of the medical record by verifying the completeness, timeliness, and authentication of documentation.
  • Manages various analysis-specific work queues and validation queues, ensuring records are processed within established turnaround times.
  • Assists with batch indexing processes (Cerner Batch Indexing - Cer Batch) to ensure efficient document management and accurate assignment of medical records.
  • Monitors and maintains inbound Summary Transition of Care (TOC) accounts, ensuring records are accurately processed and available for provider review.
  • Utilizes analytics and designated facility reports to track record deficiencies and support compliance monitoring efforts.
  • Adheres to system workflow guidelines and HIM policies, assigning and re-routing accounts as needed due to poor image quality, missing documents, or incorrect indexing.
  • Ensures all medical records are authenticated before finalizing the completion process, verifying provider signatures and documentation accuracy.
  • Meets or exceeds corporate productivity and quality standards, ensuring timely validation of medical records and adherence to HIM best practices.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree or higher in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in health information management (HIM), medical records, or healthcare data integrity required
  • Experience working with Cerner, Epic, or other EHR systems preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of medical record documentation, indexing, and compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency in EHR systems, HIM workflows, and data validation tools.
  • Ability to analyze and assign deficiencies accurately based on regulatory and organizational policies.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet productivity and quality standards.
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of The Joint Commission (TJC) standards, Medicare Conditions of Participation, and medical staff bylaws.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician preferred or
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator preferred

Your expertise will directly influence how we scale our technology to meet evolving business demands. This role partners with internal business stakeholders, service delivery teams and external telecom providers to ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective network solutions that meet business requirements and engineering standards.

Job responsibilities

  • Lead structured requirements capture engagements with business and technology stakeholders, translating connectivity needs, constraints, and non-functional requirements – including resilience, performance, compliance, and operability – into well-defined solution requirements.
  • Develop end-to-end connectivity designs aligned to approved architectural patterns and reference architectures, producing design artifacts including high-level and low-level designs, network diagrams, implementation constraints, and documented assumptions.

  • Own the full tender and bid lifecycle for telecom connectivity solutions, including the development of bid packs, coordination of RFx activities with internal sourcing partners, technical and commercial evaluation, and formal documentation of vendor selection rationale.
  • Embed resilience and operational risk controls into all connectivity designs, addressing path and carrier diversity, elimination of single points of failure, serviceability and monitoring requirements, and clearly defined demarcation and escalation models.
  • Lead design reviews and architecture governance, managing design exceptions with documented risk acceptance and ensuring all design decisions adhere to established engineering standards and controls.

  • Lead the design and delivery of telecom connectivity solutions across the APAC region by leveraging deep expertise in carrier networks, emerging technologies, pricing models, and supplier capabilities, while collaborating with service providers, vendors, and internal engineering teams throughout the bid and solution lifecycle to ensure technically robust, commercially viable, and deliverable outcomes.

  • Manage supplier relationships and performance governance, holding providers accountable to SLAs, driving service improvement plans, and conducting recurring quality and performance reviews.

title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
description:
Competitive Comp • Early Stage Equity • Austin, TX • Early Hire

Equal Parts is building the operating system for the modern insurance agency. Through a combination of acquisitions, in-house operations, and AI systems, we're creating a platform that scales relationships, not headcount.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a core layer of our platform — the systems the rest of the company runs on. Working with Engineering, Operations, Agencies, and Finance, you'll own the foundation, operational workflows, integrations, and the automation that sits on top of them. Your users aren't abstractions — you'll sit with the agency owners, producers, and service teams who work in this product every day.

The best person for this role takes an ambiguous, unowned problem area and drives it to shipped with minimal hand-holding. You prioritize hard, and you're technical enough to earn engineering's trust without prescribing the solution. It's early, so you'll help define the product function as much as the product.

What You'll Do

  • Own problems end to end — from framing the problem to a shipped, measured outcome

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product, with a track record of owning products end to end — discovery through launch and iteration
  • Measurable impact you can point to and explain
  • Experience working directly with users to understand their problems, and with complex systems to solve them
  • Strong product instincts and the judgment to prioritize ruthlessly
  • Technical fluency: comfortable reasoning about data models, workflows, and system design alongside engineers — without prescribing the implementation
  • Genuine appetite for ambiguity — this is an early-stage role where you'll define the layer as you build it

Nice to have — any of these is a plus, none required:

  • Insurance, fintech, or another operationally complex, regulated industry
  • Hands-on with AI and agentic systems, including lightweight prototyping ("vibe coding") to pressure-test ideas
  • Data platforms, BI tools, or data warehouses

  • Working directly with founders and executives

title: Registered Dietitian
description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

Provides nutritional services for the facility’s in-center and home patients as applicable in order to maximize the patient’s nutritional status and improve clinical outcomes. Functions as a member of the interdisciplinary healthcare team, supporting the FMCNA commitment to the Quality Enhancement Program (QEP) and Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAI) activities. Actively participates in process improvement activities that enhance the likelihood that patients will achieve their individualized patient-specific goals as determined by the patient’s physician.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assesses patient’s knowledge of diet and kidney disease and provides education appropriate to patient’s learning needs regarding the relationship of diet and kidney disease and the impact on the treatment process.
  • Provides patient specific detailed education to patient/family/caregiver regarding nutritional status, adequacy measures and results, fluid status, and all nutrition related lab parameters pertaining to their disease process.
  • Completes nutritional assessment and participates in the interdisciplinary comprehensive assessments.
  • Participates with the interdisciplinary team in the development of a written, individualized comprehensive plan of care that specifies the services necessary to address the patient’s needs, in accordance with established Federal and, where applicable, state licensure guidelines.
  • Calculates diet prescription according to standard of practice.
  • Completes progress notes on all chronic dialysis patients according to established FMCNA guidelines. Maintains complete and accurate documentation of all appropriate information in medical record according to established FMCNA policies and Federal and state regulations.
  • Provides patient with ongoing nutrition assessment and outcome-oriented nutrition counseling necessary to assist patient in achieving and sustaining an effective nutritional status.
  • Identifies malnourished patients as well as patients at risk for malnutrition and works collaboratively with interdisciplinary team to identify appropriate interventions, resources or solutions. Reviews each patient’s albumin level and body weight at least monthly. Implements plan of care with involvement of patient/family/caregiver.
  • Monitors adherence and response to nutrition therapy, adjusts therapy as needed to achieve and sustain an effective nutritional status, documents why the patient was unable to achieve the goals and implements the plan of care to address issues impacting the patient’s ability to achieve the goals.
  • Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on Urea Kinetic Modeling recommendations to achieve the physician’s prescription of Kt/V.
  • Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on management and recommendations for mineral metabolism and renal bone disease, anemia and iron status, nutritional status, psychosocial status, vascular access, modality, rehabilitation status and sodium/volume control.
  • Adheres to FMCNA algorithm and medical record policies.
  • Reports on nutrition QAI results and participates in the interdisciplinary QAI program.
  • Collaborates and coordinates with team members in provision of Pre-ESRD education as appropriate.
  • When appropriate, works with Case Manager to coordinate plan of care for patient education and identifies candidates to refer to physician for nutritional supplements, as per disease management agreements.
  • Reviews nutrition related lab results:
  • Counsels patient and/or caregiver and formulates appropriate action.
  • Recommends treatment changes to the interdisciplinary team as appropriate.
  • Communicates with physician and/or facility staff regarding lab results as appropriate.
  • Communicates lab results and recommended treatment changes to providers of patient care in nursing facilities (i.e., hospitals, short term and long-term care facilities).
  • Participates in pertinent staff meetings (i.e., general staff, quality improvement), Care plan meetings, and others as applicable.
  • Consults with FMS Corporate Dietitian regarding nutrition concerns as needed.
  • Maintains and improves knowledge and skills for a competent and innovative practice.
  • Maintains dietetic registration and continuing education hours as specified by American Dietetic Association and state licensure regulations where applicable.
  • Collaborates with interdisciplinary team, ensuring that all work areas are safe and clean.
  • Other nutrition management duties as assigned.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
    • The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials.
    • Day to day work includes desk and personal computer work and interaction with patients, facility staff and physicians.
    • The position requires travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community. Travel to regional, Business Unit and Corporate meetings may be required.

SUPERVISION:

  • None

EDUCATION AND REQUIRED CREDENTIALS:

  • Registered Dietitian as per Commission on Dietetic Registration
  • Board Certified Specialist in Renal Nutrition encouraged.
  • Current state licensure if applicable.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:

  • Minimum of 1-year professional work experience in clinical nutrition as a Registered Dietitian.
  • Previous renal experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership competencies and skills for the position, including ability to teach, strong organizational skills, excellent communication, customer service, relationship development, results orientation, team building and decision making.
  • Able to perform responsibilities with minimum supervision.
  • Basic computer skills required.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Principal Advisor Treaty Policy
description:

Our vision: Nature is thriving in Aotearoa | Te Oranga o te Ao Tūroa

Mō te tūranga | About the role

We have a new DOC Treaty Operating Model that will strengthen how we work with Treaty partners and bring greater clarity to expectations, roles, and accountability across the organisation. This makes it an exciting time to join our Iwi Strategy and Group Partnerships.

As Principal Advisor Treaty Policy, you will lead the coordination and stewardship of Treaty policy across DOC, ensuring Te Tiriti o Waitangi is reflected in policy settings, decision-making, and conservation outcomes.

You will provide expert advice on Treaty obligations, Section 4 of the Conservation Act, and Treaty settlement commitments, helping shape how DOC works in partnership with iwi, hapū and whānau.

Working at a senior level, you will influence outcomes through strategic policy leadership, collaboration, and trusted relationships. You will work closely with colleagues across Iwi Strategy & Partnerships group, DOC, iwi and Māori organisations, and government agencies to strengthen policy frameworks that uphold Crown commitments, strengthen the Crown-Māori relationship, and support effective conservation partnerships.

This role is suited to someone who thrives in complex policy environments and can turn strategic intent into practical, Treaty-aligned policy outcomes.

You will;

  • Lead the coordination, review, and implementation of Treaty policy frameworks, guidance, and standards across DOC.

  • Provide expert advice on Treaty obligations, Section 4 responsibilities, Treaty settlements, legislation, and strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure Treaty considerations are embedded in policy development, planning, decision-making, and organisational priorities.

  • Prepare and quality assure policy papers, briefings, strategic advice, and governance reporting.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with iwi, hapū, whānau, Treaty partners, government agencies, and conservation stakeholders.

  • Collaborate across DOC and government to deliver Treaty-aligned policy outcomes that reflect te ao Māori, mātauranga Māori, and tikanga Māori.

  • Strengthen Treaty policy capability across DOC through guidance, tools, coaching, and support for effective implementation and engagement.

  • Strong understanding of Section 4 of the Conservation Act and its practical application.

title: Kan vi ikke bare gjøre knappen litt større?
description:
Neida. Vi vet at god UX handler om langt mer enn knapper, farger og pikselperfeksjon. Det handler om å forstå mennesker, arbeidsprosesser og behov, og om å designe løsninger som gjør hverdagen enklere.

Vi ser nå etter en erfaren UX-designer som vil være med å videreutvikle NGFLYT; et av NorgesGruppens viktigste system for vareflyt og butikkdrift. Hos oss får du jobbe med løsningene som optimaliserer verdikjeden – fra grossist til butikk. Det involverer komplekse arbeidsprosesser, mobile arbeidsflater og digitale verktøy som brukes av tusenvis av ansatte hver eneste dag.

Hva vil du gjøre hos oss?
Som UX-designer vil du være en sentral del av et tverrfaglig produktteam med utviklere, produkteiere og fagressurser fra butikk og ASKO. Dette er en rolle med stor påvirkningskraft, hvor du får være med på å forme løsninger som brukes daglig i noen av Norges største butikkjeder.

Hos oss får du jobbe med produkter som har direkte påvirkning på hverdagen til tusenvis av ansatte i butikk og logistikk. Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med høy grad av autonomi, korte beslutningsveier og muligheten til å se effekten av arbeidet ditt i praksis.

Du vil jobbe med hele designprosessen – fra å forstå brukernes behov til å utvikle konsepter, prototyper og ferdige løsninger som settes i produksjon. Du vil blant annet jobbe med:

  • Kartlegging av brukerbehov og arbeidsprosesser

  • Konseptutvikling og tjenestedesign

  • Interaksjonsdesign for web, butikkterminaler og mobile løsninger

  • Utforming av prototyper og designleveranser i Figma

  • Brukertesting og validering av løsninger

  • Samarbeid med utviklere og produkteiere gjennom hele utviklingsløpet

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har høyere utdanning eller tilsvarende relevant erfaring

  • Har erfaring fra tverrfaglige produktteam og smidig produktutvikling

  • Er sterk på interaksjonsdesign og komplekse brukerreiser

  • Har erfaring med design av mobile løsninger

  • Har erfaring med brukerinnsikt, observasjon, intervjuer og testing

  • Har god forståelse for universell utforming og WCAG

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du har disse egenskapene:

Selvstendig og initiativrik
Du tar eierskap til eget fagområde, driver arbeidet fremover og evner å skape felles forståelse på tvers av fagområder.

Formidlingssterk
Du kommuniserer designvalg og anbefalinger på en tydelig og overbevisende måte.

Faglig nysgjerrig
Du ønsker å utvikle både deg selv, produktene du jobber med og fagmiljøet rundt deg.

Mer enn bare en IT-jobb, her får du både fag og fellesskap!

Vi jobber i tverrfaglige team og har et godt samarbeid på tvers av fagområder. Her er det høyt under taket, gode faglige diskusjoner og muligheter til å både fordype deg og utforske nye retninger. Du får jobbe med løsninger som faktisk påvirker hverdagen til folk, i et konsern som satser på teknologi.

Du vil møte kolleger som ikke bare brenner for faget sitt, men som også bidrar til et inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø. Hos oss er det lett å bli kjent med folk på tvers av team og avdelinger – enten du blir med i gaming- og e-sportklubben, spiller padel etter jobb, tar en runde med golfgruppa, eller løper Holmenkollstafetten sammen med kolleger. Vi tilbyr blant annet treningsstøtte, tilgang til firmahytter og en kantine mange setter pris på.

Som en del av ansettelsesprosessen gjennomfører vi systematiske bakgrunnssjekker. For enkelte stillinger vil det også bli gjennomført en utvidet bakgrunnssjekk før ansettelse.

Do you want to work with technology that impacts the everyday lives of millions of people?

Join NorgesGruppen Data, an exciting workplace with strong professional communities and significant influence. We are more than 300 skilled employees working closely across the entire NorgesGruppen value chain, from farm to table.

With us, IT is an integral part of the business, and we invest heavily in the solutions of the future. As part of our cross-functional environment, you will help develop and deliver technology solutions that truly make a difference in people’s daily lives.

We are located in modern offices at Kalbakken and Skøyen in Oslo.
