title: ServiceNow Business Consultant
description:
Role Summary


The Business Process Consultant is the bridge between a six-month backlog and a coherent delivery plan. You will own intake, refinement, and prioritization of the client's ITSM backlog — turning a queue of accumulated stories, enhancements, and incidents into well-formed, estimable work the development team can burn down predictably. You define the velocity metrics by which this engagement will be publicly judged.


Key Responsibilities


  • Backlog mastery — inventory, classify, and prioritize the existing backlog (size, age, module, business impact) within the first 30 days; establish the burn-down baseline.
  • Requirements engineering — convert raw demand into refined stories with acceptance criteria; run refinement sessions with client process owners.
  • Process consulting — map current-state ITSM processes; identify and quantify process improvements the POD should deliver alongside backlog work.
  • Velocity & reporting — define and publish sprint velocity, commitment reliability, and quality metrics; own the data behind the weekly client status narrative.
  • UAT orchestration — design and run the UAT process with client stakeholders; protect releases from scope and quality surprises.
  • Stakeholder management — work daily with the client's operational lead and platform architect; build the trusted-advisor relationship the incumbent lost.


Required Qualifications


  • 9–12 years of relevant experience, including 6+ years in ServiceNow business analysis / process consulting roles.
  • Demonstrated ownership of large ITSM backlogs — intake models, prioritization frameworks, and refinement discipline at enterprise scale.
  • Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM data model and configuration concepts (enough to write implementable stories, not just requirements prose).
  • ITIL v4 Foundation or higher; ServiceNow CSA preferred.
  • Experience defining delivery metrics (velocity, throughput, defect escape rate) and presenting them to client leadership.
  • Excellent facilitation and written communication — your stories and your status reporting are the engagement's public record.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Regulated-industry experience (medical device, pharma, healthcare).
  • Exposure to Now Assist / AI-assisted ITSM workflows and where they change process design.
  • Experience working in a co-delivery model with a consulting prime.

title: Registered Dietitian
location: CA281 FMCNA W March Stockton RAI - Clinic
description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

Provides nutritional services for the facility’s in-center and home patients as applicable in order to maximize the patient’s nutritional status and improve clinical outcomes. Functions as a member of the interdisciplinary healthcare team, supporting the FMCNA commitment to the Quality Enhancement Program (QEP) and Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAI) activities. Actively participates in process improvement activities that enhance the likelihood that patients will achieve their individualized patient-specific goals as determined by the patient’s physician.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assesses patient’s knowledge of diet and kidney disease and provides education appropriate to patient’s learning needs regarding the relationship of diet and kidney disease and the impact on the treatment process.
  • Provides patient specific detailed education to patient/family/caregiver regarding nutritional status, adequacy measures and results, fluid status, and all nutrition related lab parameters pertaining to their disease process.
  • Completes nutritional assessment and participates in the interdisciplinary comprehensive assessments.
  • Participates with the interdisciplinary team in the development of a written, individualized comprehensive plan of care that specifies the services necessary to address the patient’s needs, in accordance with established Federal and, where applicable, state licensure guidelines.
  • Calculates diet prescription according to standard of practice.
  • Completes progress notes on all chronic dialysis patients according to established FMCNA guidelines. Maintains complete and accurate documentation of all appropriate information in medical record according to established FMCNA policies and Federal and state regulations.
  • Provides patient with ongoing nutrition assessment and outcome-oriented nutrition counseling necessary to assist patient in achieving and sustaining an effective nutritional status.
  • Identifies malnourished patients as well as patients at risk for malnutrition and works collaboratively with interdisciplinary team to identify appropriate interventions, resources or solutions. Reviews each patient’s albumin level and body weight at least monthly. Implements plan of care with involvement of patient/family/caregiver.
  • Monitors adherence and response to nutrition therapy, adjusts therapy as needed to achieve and sustain an effective nutritional status, documents why the patient was unable to achieve the goals and implements the plan of care to address issues impacting the patient’s ability to achieve the goals.
  • Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on Urea Kinetic Modeling recommendations to achieve the physician’s prescription of Kt/V.
  • Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team on management and recommendations for mineral metabolism and renal bone disease, anemia and iron status, nutritional status, psychosocial status, vascular access, modality, rehabilitation status and sodium/volume control.
  • Adheres to FMCNA algorithm and medical record policies.
  • Reports on nutrition QAI results and participates in the interdisciplinary QAI program.
  • Collaborates and coordinates with team members in provision of Pre-ESRD education as appropriate.
  • When appropriate, works with Case Manager to coordinate plan of care for patient education and identifies candidates to refer to physician for nutritional supplements, as per disease management agreements.
  • Reviews nutrition related lab results:
  • Counsels patient and/or caregiver and formulates appropriate action.

description:
Hei sairaanhoitaja – tule vahvistamaan Meilahden päivystyksen tiimiä!

Meilahden päivystyksessä hoidamme lähes kaikkien erikoisalojen potilaita, jotka ovat äkillisesti sairastuneet tai loukkaantuneet ja tarvitsevat välitöntä hoitoa. Vaativan erikoissairaanhoidon osalta palvelemme koko Uudenmaan aluetta.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
* Kokemusta päivystystyöstä
* Hyviä työyhteisö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ratkaisukeskeistä ja joustavaa otetta vaihteleviin tilanteisiin
* Kykyä priorisoida ja hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia
* Halua oppia uutta ja jakaa omaa osaamistasi

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
* Merkityksellisen työn akuuttihoidon parissa
* Yksilöllisen perehdytyksen ja osaavan tiimin tuen
* Mukavan, moniammatillisen työyhteisön
* Mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kouluttautua
* HUSin henkilöstöedut – ja ennen kaikkea mahtavat kollegat

Työ päivystyksessä on nopeatempoista, vaihtelevaa ja välillä vaativaakin – mutta juuri siksi se tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittyä, onnistua ja tehdä aidosti merkityksellistä työtä.

Työ on nopeatempoista ja mukaansatempaavaa – juuri sinulle, joka nautit haasteista ja vaihtelevista tilanteista.
* Tehtäväkohtainen palkka 3146,75- 3192,88 €/kk
* Aloitus1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

Haastattelut järjestetään perjantaina 21.8. ja maanantaina 24.8.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakulomake määräaikaan mennessä.
Lisätietoja antaa: Osastonhoitaja Janica Lugora, janica.lugora@hus.fi, 040 334 7340

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Tietoa Akuutista

Me yli tuhat akuuttihoidon ammattilaista työskentelemme HUSissa päivittäin potilaiden parhaaksi, heitä palvellen. Vastaamme HYKS-sairaanhoitoalueella sairaankuljetuksesta, aikuisten päivystyksistä, Päivystysapu 116117 -toiminnasta, HUS alueen ensihoidosta ja valtakunnallisesta Myrkytystietokeskuksesta. Akuutin päivystyslinjalla hoidamme potilaita sekä päivystyksissä että päivystysvalvonnoissa Meilahden, Malmin, Jorvin, Peijaksen, Hyvinkään, Lohjan ja Porvoon sairaaloissa.

제11조(채용서류의 반환 등) ① 구인자는 구직자의 채용 여부가 확정된 이후 구직자(확정된 채용 대상자는 제외한다)가 채용서류의 반환을 청구하는 경우에는 본인임을 확인한 후 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 반환하여야 한다. 다만, 제7조제1항에 따라 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 구인자의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니 하다. ② 제1항에 따른 구직자의 채용서류 반환 청구는 서면 또는 전자적 방법 등 노동부령으로 정하는 바에 따라 하여야 한다. ③ 구인자는 제1항에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 대통령령으로 정하는 기간 동안 채용서류를 보관하여야 한다. 다만, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 구인자에게 책임없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우 구인자는 제1항에 따른 채용서류의 반환의무를 이행한 것으로 본다. ④ 구인자는 대통령령으로 정한 반환의 청구기간이 지난 경우 및 채용서류를 반환하지 아니한 경우에는 ｢개인정보보호법｣에 따라 채용서류를 파기하여야 한다. ⑤ 제1항에 따른 채용서류의 반환에 소요되는 비용은 원칙적으로 구인자가 부담한다. 다만, 구인자는 대통령령으로 정하는 범위에서 채용서류의 반환에 소요되는 비용을 구직자에게 부담하게 할 수 있다.
